findings.summary: Log-scrub test never wires createLogCapture() into the production pino logger; redaction is not exercised end-to-end.
findings.suggested_fix: Refactor: createLogCapture() before main.ts import, inject capture.destination into the production pino logger (via DI or vi.mock of shared/logger.ts), then run the full auth flow and assert capture.notContainsAny([password, sessions, refresh, csrf]).

findings.summary: Test exercises loadEnv() directly instead of buildApp({...env, JWT_SECRET:'too-short'}) as task spec requires; production boot path not covered.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a test case that calls buildApp with a short JWT_SECRET (or asserts main.ts boot fails with that env) so the user-facing fail-fast path is verified, not just the Zod schema.

findings.summary: Test reimplements seed logic in local runSeed() rather than executing apps/api/src/seed/main.ts; a regression in main.ts would not be caught.
findings.suggested_fix: Invoke the real seed binary via execa/spawn against the test container DATABASE_URL twice, then assert user count=2. Avoids drift between test fixture and production seed code.

findings.summary: Uses vi.spyOn(defaultPasswordHasher,'verify') instead of buildApp({hasher: vi.fn(...)}) DI per task spec; still asserts the invariant.
findings.suggested_fix: If buildApp DI is preferred for hasher (per task description), accept a hasher option in buildApp and inject the vi.fn spy. Otherwise, document the deliberate deviation in the test header.
